audit_items.proof_trace: The property premise is incorrect: a zero flash_loan_fee_rate does not enable free borrowing. In borrow_flash_loan (market.move:L813-814), the computed fee is asserted non-zero (`assert!(fee != 0, reserve_flash_loan_fee_too_small)`) before any funds are released; if fee_rate=0, int_mul returns 0 and the transaction aborts. The FlashLoan hot-potato can only be created through this function (Move type system enforces no alternative construction path), so the usage-time guard is sufficient and there is no bypass.
